title: NUniversity course.json locale block
description: Shape required for each non-English locale block (pt, es) in content/courses/<slug>/course.json. The course validator warns on a missing block; this schema is the contract for writing one.

title.description: Translated course title. Displayed on course cards and used as the locale <title>.

description.description: Translated full description (course.json en.description style: 1–3 sentences).

difficulty.description: Capitalized Portuguese difficulty (display). Lesson frontmatter difficulty stays the English enum.
